note: The four praxis routing policies. routes are routing-tier names, not hardware; read a run's pool map for what actually served it. Keys stay A/B/C/D because summary.arm is recorded evidence.

configs.name: all-gpu
configs.behavior: Every request goes to one through-stack route: no classifier, no CPU, no failover.

configs.name: gpu-small
configs.behavior: Classifier: SIMPLE/MEDIUM go to the small route; COMPLEX/REASONING go to the large route. Either route can take over on failure.

configs.name: round-robin
configs.behavior: Alternate across CPU and GPU with no classifier.

configs.name: hybrid
configs.behavior: General entry: SIMPLE/MEDIUM to CPU, COMPLEX/REASONING to GPU. Sensitive entry: CPU or approved GPU only; fail closed.
